history.title: History of Zoo Maravillas
history.paragraph: Zoo Maravillas was founded in 1995 with the aim of preserving the most endangered species and educating the public about the importance of wildlife conservation. Since its opening, we have grown significantly and become a leader in animal care.
With over 200 species from around the world, the zoo continues to be a special place for those looking to connect with nature.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to provide a safe and healthy environment for animals, promote environmental education, and contribute to species conservation through educational and research programs.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: To be an international leader in wildlife conservation, offering a space that inspires future generations to care for and respect animals and their environment.
